purpose: Measure paired flank-specific channel effects after uniform remote-channel changes failed the separation objective.
scientific_risk_addressed: Readout-feature contributions do not identify local channel sensitivity. Probe both flanks and both signs to avoid treating the larger observed contribution of cells 3/5 as evidence that changing those cells will rescue the tasks.

motivation.meaning: Location and order share the same limiting pair; this is one joint ambiguity, not two independent failures.
motivation.uniform_change_result: Uniform +/-10% changes mainly move the background voltage; small separation changes have different signs across timesteps. No local effect direction has been established.
motivation.hypothesis: A spatially restricted channel change may alter location/order overlap differently from a uniform change. This remains untested.
motivation.groups: The existing tissue has source-1 flank neighbours 2/6, source-4 flank neighbours 3/5, and shared central neighbour 7. Test both flank pairs symmetrically in sign; keep sources and centre unchanged.
motivation.effect_interpretation: Each probe changes two cells together. It measures that group intervention, not independent single-cell derivatives or a general spatial controller.

intervention.bounds_rationale: Retain the exploratory +/-10% bound; it is not a measured biological range.
intervention.mask: Scale all membrane patches whose zero-based cell_owner plus one is in the condition's cell_ids. No other patches change.
intervention.time: Present from initialization; not a post-damage recovery or adaptive controller.
intervention.dose_caveat: Source channel availability, fractional cue inhibition and timing stay fixed. Network feedback may change ionic currents and transported charge.
intervention.area_caveat: The two flank groups have slightly different membrane areas. Equal relative permeability changes are not equal absolute channel-capacity changes; report each area-weighted change.

fixed_assay.unchanged: Initial states, gate laws, tissue geometry, source cues, source channels, central-cell channels, solver, observations and numerical tolerances.

selection.objective: Existing half-minimum opposite-label fitted-polyline distance, including segment interiors, minimized across joint tasks, relevant single-task arms and all three timesteps on selected320.
selection.requirements: A unique candidate on CPU and L4, score above 2 nV and above sham by more than 1e-15 V on both backends, backend score agreement within 1e-15 V, and complete numerical/domain/null-control qualification. Otherwise retain sham.
selection.reader_views: Retain raw frozen-source, shared-no-cue-reference-assisted and condition-calibrated views separately. A geometric gain does not establish raw transfer.
selection.negative_results: Keep every valid negative outcome and every invalid failure. Do not replace candidates or tune support, margins or strengths after seeing responses.
selection.confirmation: Freeze any selected candidate before a separate fresh-strength experiment. No held-out responses enter this pilot.

verification: Compare all generated inputs to the archived channel-sham calibration input; only the declared flank patch permeabilities may differ.
Authenticate completed-source evidence before execution. Keep the same windowed full-state runner, conservation/domain checks and CPU/L4 tolerances.
Require bitwise full-history sham reproduction. Other candidates reproduce initial states only, including no-cue and disconnected arms.
Retain restart, reordered/partitioned-world checks, complete recordings, null controls and per-case timestep score diagnostics.
Report paired changes at each timestep, both flank groups and both signs. Readout contributions are not local sensitivity estimates.
Record GPU busy, measured SM-active, coverage and per-arm kernel/archive timings; equal planned world steps need not give identical runtimes.

execution.remaining: Adapt the existing five-arm qualification harness to the five local-channel conditions and verify its historical source binding before launch.
execution.estimate_basis: 900 worlds/backend versus the completed 540-world four-hour uniform-channel pilot; includes CPU then L4 and archive handling.

scope: Calibration-only intervention design for one synthetic tissue. No local rescue, biological replication, whole-organ validation, new BETSE/BITSEY parity or multi-GPU scaling result.
